items: 【More Private, Less Odor】This cat litter box enclosure provides your cat with a secluded and comfortable toilet space, prevent odors and litter, say goodbye to smells and mess

【Ample Storage Space】The upper part of this cat litter box furniture features a spacious countertop and two open storage compartments (one large and one small), making it easy to organize cat food, treats, toys, and other items to meet your various storage needs

【Reduce Cat Litter Scattering】The L-shaped aisle at the hidden litter box entrance features a built-in scratching mat that both traps litter and provides a scratching surface, keeping the space clean. In addition, the Velcro straps on the bottom of the cat scratching pad prevent it from shifting

【Multiple Uses】This kitty litter furniture can serve as a private cat toilet or a comfortable sleeping cat house. Its uniquely farmhouse barn-style design also makes it a suitable addition to your home as a end table, TV stand, or bedside table

【Multiple Functions】corner locking plates enhance stability; double-door latches with magnetic design effectively prevent cats from opening and dog proof; four anti-slip pads on the bottom prevent scratches on the floor

【Thoughtful Back Panel Design】The upper back panel of the cat furniture litter box features a convenient hole for easy access to the set-top box data cable; the lower back panel has 5 ventilation holes to effectively reduce odors
【Easy to Assemble】With the instructions and labeled components, you can quickly assemble this hidden litter box furniture. The cat litter box is made of FSC certified wood
